steps.text: A project is a folder you work in. Open one with + New, then open project. If cornercase started in a folder, that folder is already your first project.
steps.title: Projects

steps.text: A workspace is a line of work. In a git repository each one can get its own worktree, so several agents change code side by side without touching each other's files. Make one with + New, then new workspace. Outside a repository the default workspace is all you need.
steps.title: Workspaces

steps.text: Each tab runs shells. Open one with + Tab, or right-click a pane for its menu: split it, or close it. Drag a border to resize.
steps.title: Tabs and panes

steps.text: Start an agent in this workspace with a first prompt. Edit the idea below, then start it. If the agent asks whether to trust the folder, that answer is yours.
steps.title: Your first prompt

steps.text: A tab shows what its agent does: ◐ working, ! needs you, ✓ finished, ○ idle, ● marked for review. The agents section lists every agent in every project; a click jumps to the one that needs you.
steps.title: Agents and their status

steps.text: In Settings, under More: the default agent and its mode, resuming agents after a restart, desktop notifications and sound, the working icon and the icon bar. Nothing changes until you change it.
steps.title: Essential settings

steps.text: Help, at the bottom of the sidebar, opens this tour again, a catalogue of short tours for the rest of cornercase, and the docs.
steps.title: Where to go next

steps.text: Issues lists the issues of GitHub, GitLab, Linear, Jira and more. Open it.
steps.title: Issues

steps.text: Pick an issue and press start: cornercase makes a worktree on its branch and starts an agent with the issue as its prompt.
steps.title: Start an agent on one

steps.text: Schedule puts the issue in the queue, to start at a time you choose.
steps.title: Later

steps.text: Changes shows the diff of this workspace. Open it.
steps.title: Changes

steps.text: Hover a hunk: ask agent pastes its place into the workspace's agent, so you can say what to fix.
steps.title: Ask the agent

steps.text: Mark a file viewed to fold it; it opens again when it changes. Commits and All compare against a branch.
steps.title: Viewed

steps.text: TODO keeps a list of what is next. Open it.
steps.title: TODO

steps.text: Click + New TODO and type one.
steps.title: Add an item

steps.text: The ▸ of an item sends its text to an agent as a prompt, and checks it off once the agent takes it.
steps.title: Send it to an agent
